acts.desc:
Producer Ben Calhoun tells Ira about a secret move his friend uses all the time — the "good guy
discount" — that gets Ben's friend money off all sorts of items when he's shopping.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc: Ben tries the good guy discount, to see if he can pull it off, as Ira tags along.
acts.title: Takes One To Know One

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Mike Birbiglia has this story about a time his good guy-ness was called into question. Mike is about to go on a new tour called "Thank God For Jokes" that will take him to 100 cities. You can find show dates at his website.
acts.title: The Heels On The Bus

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Julia DeWitt tells the story of someone who goes to incredible lengths to do a favor for another guy, even though the guy won't ever be able to know about it. Julia's story originally aired on Snap Judgment.
acts.title: No Man Left Behind

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Radio producer Scott Carrier quit his job at a low moment in his life. His wife left him and took the kids. And he got a job interviewing schizophrenics for some medical researchers. After doing it a while, he began to wonder if he was a schizophrenic himself. Scott has a new podcast called Home of the Brave.
acts.title: The Test
